en: A monochrome postcard view of a quiet, curving street lined with trees and iron fences. On the left stands a large, light‑colored institutional building with a steep tiled roof and arched ground-floor openings, identified in the caption as the post office. A few people walk along the street and the sky is filled with light clouds. The style and printing suggest an early 20th‑century European town scene.
